summary: Major miss: AI failed twice, Nick had to ask three times
detailed_context: Nick received an incomplete/truncated response. He politely asked the AI to continue and produce visible output. The AI attempted again but delivered another truncated response. Now Nick is asking a third time with terse 'Complete this thread'—a clear pattern of repeated requests for basic task completion. This signals strong frustration with fundamental failure to deliver. The AI should have provided a complete, visible response on the first attempt.
